SADE: local adaptation only; exact published reproduction unavailable (paid providers)
deterministic_repeats: rule baseline repeats are not independent evidence; identical model outputs audited

execution_retry_policy.model_output_failures: final empirical outcomes; never retried for accuracy
execution_retry_policy.retry_only: infrastructure failure, interrupted execution, or unverified restoration
execution_retry_policy.selection: earliest restored model outcome; preserve all raw attempts

information_access.others: matched live read-only tools and topology; role/loop/retrieval vary as declared
information_access.plain_llm: ticket and public topology; no observations
information_access.rag_only: ticket, topology and retrieved passages; no tools

no_circuit_breaker: no-progress breaker removed; hard time/token/tool caps retained
no_oversight: LLM Oversight removed; containment, policy, and twin retained
no_twin: twin removed; fundamental scoped executor and deterministic policy retained
upstream_evaluation: pending independent real validation; never substituted with local cases
